en: Hello everyone! Welcome back to... the AB English Podcast. I'm Mia, and—oh—I'm so happy you're joining us today!
zh: 大家好！歡迎回到……AB English Podcast。我是 Mia，喔──非常開心你今天來加入我們！

en: And I'm Alex. It's great to be here! Well... how are you doing today, Mia? Wow, you look very energetic!
zh: 我是 Alex。很高興在這裡！嗯……Mia，你今天怎麼樣？哇，你看起來很有活力！

en: I'm doing great! But... actually, I had a bit of a funny—yet slightly awkward—experience at a party last weekend.
zh: 我很好！不過……其實，上週末我在一個派對上有點有趣、但有點尷尬的經驗。

en: Oh? What happened? Did you meet someone interesting?
zh: 喔？發生什麼事了？你遇到什麼有趣的人嗎？

en: I did! But... when a new friend looked at me and asked, "So, tell me about yourself," my mind suddenly... went completely blank!
zh: 遇到啦！但是……當一個新朋友看著我問：「那，跟我說說你自己吧」，我的腦子突然……完全空白了！

en: Well, that happens to almost everyone! Honestly... even in our native language, it can be a really tricky question.
zh: 那種事幾乎每個人都會遇到！說實在的……就算是母語，有時這問題也真的很難回答。

en: Exactly! I panicked... and started talking about how many eggs I ate for breakfast, and then—silence. Oh, it was so embarrassing!
zh: 沒錯！我慌了……然後開始講我早餐吃了幾顆蛋，接著——沉默。天啊，超尷尬的！

en: Haha! In social situations... being asked that out of nowhere can really catch you off guard.
zh: 哈哈！在社交場合……被莫名其妙問到這種問題真的會讓人措手不及。

en: That is so true! And... well, that is exactly why we are here today.
zh: 真是太對了！而且……嗯，這正是我們今天在這裡的原因。

en: That's right! We want to make self- introductions feel... as simple, natural, and fun as chatting with a good friend.
zh: 沒錯！我們想讓自我介紹變得……像跟好朋友聊天一樣簡單、自然又有趣。

en: Oh, before we dive into our practice... here are two great features of our channel for all our new learners!
zh: 喔，在我們進入練習之前……先跟所有新學員介紹頻道的兩個好功能！

en: First... we provide human-accurate captions in twenty-nine different languages for every single video!
zh: 首先……我們為每支影片提供二十九種語言的人工精準字幕！

en: Yes! Make sure to turn on the subtitles in your native language... so you can understand with zero stress!
zh: 是的！記得把字幕開成你的母語……這樣你就能毫無壓力地理解內容！

en: Second... our dynamic English and Chinese on- screen subtitles let you easily read along—while listening!
zh: 第二……我們動態的英中雙語螢幕字幕讓你一邊聽一邊輕鬆跟讀！

en: That is our core philosophy—Always Better Everyday!
zh: 那是我們的核心理念──Always Better Everyday！

en: And to make your learning even better... we provide two amazing, completely free practice tools for our fans!
zh: 為了讓你的學習更好……我們還為粉絲提供兩個超棒、完全免費的練習工具！

en: That's right! After this video, you can use our special dictation learning player... which is designed with multiple powerful learning modes.
zh: 沒錯！看完這支影片後，你可以使用我們的專屬聽寫學習播放器……它有多種強大的學習模式。

en: You can use A-B loops for intensive listening... blind listening to train your ears, and typing dictation to test your memory.
zh: 你可以用 A-B 迴圈做強化聽力……盲聽訓練你的耳朵，還有輸入聽寫來測試記憶。

en: Wow, it even features a voice validation mode! You can speak directly into the microphone, and... well, the system will instantly verify your pronunciation.
zh: 哇，它甚至有語音驗證模式！你可以直接對麥克風講話，然後……系統會立即驗證你的發音。

en: Yes! You can also use our AI conversation tutor to practice one-on-one speaking with AI... using the exact vocabulary from today's lesson!
zh: 是的！你也可以使用我們的 AI 會話導師和 AI 一對一練習口說……使用的就是今天課程裡的精準詞彙！

en: Both tools are completely free with no login required... at all! You can find the links in the description box below.
zh: 這兩個工具完全免費，根本不需要登入！你可以在下方說明欄找到連結。

en: So... Alex, are you ready to help everyone practice self-introductions today?
zh: 那麼……Alex，你準備好幫大家練習自我介紹了嗎？

en: Oh, I am definitely ready. Let's get started!
zh: 喔，我當然準備好了。那我們開始吧！

en: So, Mia... why don't you demonstrate first?
zh: 那麼，Mia……你先示範如何做？

en: Sure! Let's start with the simplest first step... "What is your name?"
zh: 好！我們先從最簡單的第一步開始……「你叫什麼名字？」

en: My name is Mia... M-I-A.
zh: 我叫 Mia──M-I-A。

en: Nice to meet you, Mia! My name is Alex... A-L-E-X.
zh: 很高興認識你，Mia！我叫 Alex──A-L-E-X。

en: Well, spelling out your name makes it much easier for others to remember!
zh: 嗯，把名字拼出來會讓別人比較容易記住你！

en: That's right! The next natural question is... "Where are you from?"
zh: 沒錯！下一個很自然的問題是……「你從哪裡來？」

en: I am from Canada! Hmm... what about you, Alex?
zh: 我來自加拿大！嗯……你呢，Alex？

en: Well, I am from the United States.
zh: 我來自美國。

en: Oh, the United States! Many people then ask... "Do you live in a big city?"
zh: 哦，美國！那很多人會接著問……「你住在大城市嗎？」

en: Yes, I live in a big city.
zh: 是的，我住在大城市。

en: Hmm... living in a big city is convenient, but... is it noisy?
zh: 嗯……住在大城市很方便，但是……會不會很吵？

en: It's busy and loud, yes... but I love the energy—and the late-night cafes! What about you?
zh: 那裡很熱鬧也很吵，對...但我愛那種活力——還有深夜咖啡館！你呢？

en: Well, I live in a small town. It's very... quiet and peaceful.
zh: 嗯，我住在一個小鎮。那裡非常...安靜又祥和。

en: Oh, a small town? Do you... do you like it there?
zh: 哦，小鎮？你...你喜歡住那裡嗎？

en: I do. I really enjoy... well, the calm lifestyle.
zh: 我喜歡。我真的很享受...嗯，平靜的生活方式。

en: That sounds so peaceful. Hmm... do you live in a house, or an apartment?
zh: 那聽起來很寧靜。嗯...你住房子還是公寓？

en: I live in a small house... with a beautiful garden.
zh: 我住在一棟小房子裡...有一個漂亮的花園。

en: Oh, a garden! I... I love gardens so much.
zh: 喔，有花園！我...我超喜歡花園的。

en: On weekends, I just love taking care of my plants. What about you, Mia?
zh: 週末我就愛照顧我的植物。你呢，Mia？

en: Well... I actually live in an apartment downtown.
zh: 嗯...其實我住在市中心的一間公寓。

en: Oh? Is it... a big apartment?
zh: 哦？那是...很大的公寓嗎？

en: No, it's a small apartment—but it's very nice and cozy!
zh: 不，是一間小公寓—但很漂亮又舒適！

en: That's lovely! Well... what about age? People often ask, "Alex, how old are you?"
zh: 那很好！那...年齡呢？人們常常會問，『Alex，你幾歲？』

en: Well, I am 28 years old. What about you, Mia?
zh: 嗯，我28歲。你呢，Mia？

en: I am 25 years old!
zh: 我25歲！

en: Oh, 25! That is... a truly wonderful age.
zh: 喔，25！那真的是...一個很美好的年紀。

en: Now... for a big question in social situations!
zh: 現在...在社交場合的一個大問題！

en: Oh, I'm ready! What is it?
zh: 喔，我準備好了！是什麼？

en: What do you do, Alex?
zh: 你做什麼工作，Alex？

en: Ah, this is such an important question! Beginners often confuse it with... "what are you doing right now?"
zh: 啊，這是個很重要的問題！初學者常把它跟...『你現在在做什麼？』搞混。

en: Exactly! But it actually means... "what is your job?"
zh: 沒錯！但它其實是問...『你的職業是什麼？』

en: Well, I am an English teacher... on our podcast!
zh: 嗯，我是個英文老師...在我們的播客上教英文！

en: And Alex is... a very patient and friendly teacher!
zh: 而且Alex是個...非常有耐心又親切的老師！

en: Oh, thank you! I truly love my job because—well, I get to help people improve every day! What about you, Mia?
zh: 喔，謝謝！我真的很愛我的工作，因為—嗯，我可以每天幫助別人進步！你呢，Mia？

en: I am a student! I am currently studying... at university.
zh: 我是學生！我目前正在大學裡念書。

en: Oh, a student! What do you study?
zh: 哦，學生！你念什麼？

en: I study art! I just love to draw... and paint pictures.
zh: 我念藝術！我就是喜歡畫畫...和畫圖畫。

en: Art! Wow, that is so creative. Do you... enjoy your studies?
zh: 藝術！哇，那真有創意。你...喜歡你的課嗎？

en: Yes, I love it! It's really fun... and inspiring.
zh: 是的，我很喜歡！真的很有趣...也很有啟發性。

en: An art student and an English teacher—we make a great team!
zh: 一位藝術學生和一位英文老師——我們真是絕佳組合！

en: You know... after talking about jobs, sharing family details really brings people closer together.
zh: 你知道的...在談到工作之後，分享家庭細節真的能讓人更親近。

en: So true! Do you have any brothers or sisters, Mia?
zh: 說得對！你有兄弟姊妹嗎，Mia？

en: Yes, I have one brother. His name is Tom.
zh: 有，我有一個哥哥。他叫Tom。

en: Oh, is Tom... older or younger than you?
zh: 喔，Tom是...比你年長還是年幼？

en: He is older. He is... 29 years old.
zh: 他比較大。他...29歲。

en: Oh! So... he is one year older than me!
zh: 哦！所以……他比我大一歲！

en: Yes, exactly! What about you, Alex? Do you have... any siblings?
zh: 對，沒錯！你呢，Alex？你有……兄弟姊妹嗎？

en: Yes, I have one sister. Her name is Sarah.
zh: 有，我有一個姊姊。她叫Sarah。

en: Oh, is Sarah... a student too?
zh: 哦，Sarah……也是學生嗎？

en: Yes, she studies music. She plays the piano... very well!
zh: 是的，她念音樂。她鋼琴彈得……非常好！

en: A music student! Wow, that is so wonderful. What about... your parents?
zh: 音樂系的學生！哇，真棒。那……你的父母呢？

en: Well, my mother is a children's book author, and my father is a doctor... in a hospital.
zh: 嗯，我媽媽是兒童書作者，我爸爸是醫生……在醫院工作。

en: Oh, a writer and a doctor! You have such a wonderful family, Alex!
zh: 喔，是作家又是醫生！你家真棒，Alex！

en: Thank you. What about... your parents, Mia?
zh: 謝謝。Mia，你的父母呢？

en: Well, my mother is an elementary school teacher, and my father is a chef... in a restaurant!
zh: 嗯，我媽媽是小學老師，我爸爸是廚師……在餐廳工作！

en: Oh, a chef! Wow, does he cook delicious meals for you... at home?
zh: 喔，是廚師！哇，他會在家為你做美味的料理嗎？

en: Yes, he does! The food is always... absolutely amazing!
zh: 會的！他的菜總是……絕對令人驚豔！

en: Oh, I am so jealous! That... sounds absolutely delicious.
zh: 哇，我好羨慕！聽起來真的超好吃。

en: Now, how about pets? ...Do you have any pets, Alex?
zh: 那寵物呢？……Alex，你有寵物嗎？

en: Oh, yes! I have a dog. His name is Max.
zh: 喔，有的！我有一隻狗。他叫Max。

en: Max! Oh... what kind of dog is he?
zh: Max！喔……他是什麼品種的狗？

en: Well, he is a small brown dog. He is super playful—and always wagging his tail happily!
zh: 嗯，他是一隻小型棕色狗。超愛玩——而且總是開心地搖尾巴！

en: Aw, he sounds so cute! I... I really want to meet Max someday!
zh: 哇，聽起來好可愛！我……真的很想哪天見到Max！

en: Maybe you can! What about you, Mia? Do you... do you have a pet?
zh: 或許你可以見到！Mia，你呢？你……有寵物嗎？

en: Yes! I have a cat. Her name is... Luna.
zh: 有！我有一隻貓。她叫……Luna。

en: Luna! Oh, what does she look like?
zh: Luna！哦，她長什麼樣子？

en: She is a black and white cat. She is very quiet... and loves sleeping in sunny spots all day!
zh: 她是黑白相間的貓。非常安靜……喜歡整天躺在有陽光的地方睡覺！

en: A cat that loves naps—now that sounds like a classic cat life!
zh: 喜歡打盹的貓——這聽起來就是典型的貓生活！

en: Haha, it really is! She has... a wonderful life.
zh: 哈哈，真的就是！她有……美好的生活。

en: Now, let's talk about our favorite things! ...Starting with food: What is your favorite food?
zh: 現在，來聊聊我們最喜歡的東西！……從食物開始：你最喜歡的食物是什麼？

en: Hmm... I think my favorite food is pizza!
zh: 嗯……我想我最喜歡的食物是披薩！

en: Pizza! Oh, that's a classic choice. What... what toppings do you like?
zh: 披薩！哦，那是經典選擇。你喜歡……什麼配料？

en: I love vegetable pizza—with peppers, tomatoes, and extra cheese! What about you?
zh: 我喜歡蔬菜披薩——有甜椒、番茄，加大量起司！你呢？

en: Well, I love pepperoni pizza... but my number one favorite is definitely pasta!
zh: 嗯，我喜歡臘腸披薩……但我最愛的絕對是義大利麵！

en: Oh, pasta is delicious! ...So, what is your favorite color?
zh: 喔，義大利麵好好吃！……那你最喜歡的顏色是什麼？

en: My favorite color is green—like the trees and grass in nature. What about you?
zh: 我最喜歡的顏色是綠色——像大自然的樹和草。你呢？

en: My favorite color is blue. It feels... calm, like the ocean and the sky.
zh: 我最喜歡的顏色是藍色。感覺很平靜，像海洋和天空。

en: What are your hobbies, Alex? I mean... what do you do for fun?
zh: Alex，你的興趣是什麼？我是說……你平常喜歡做什麼？

en: Oh, I love listening to classic rock music!
zh: 喔，我喜歡聽古典搖滾音樂！

en: Rock music! Wow, very cool. Do you... play sports too?
zh: 搖滾樂！哇，好酷。你……也有在做運動嗎？

en: Yes! I play soccer with my friends every Saturday. It... keeps me energetic! What about you, Mia?
zh: 有啊！我每個星期六都跟朋友踢足球。那……讓我很有活力！你呢，Mia？

en: Well, besides painting, I love reading adventure books... and watching animated movies!
zh: 嗯，除了畫畫，我還喜歡看冒險書……和看動畫電影！

en: Animated movies have so much imagination! But I love comedy movies... because, well, I love laughing.
zh: 動畫電影充滿想像力！但我愛喜劇片……因為，嗯，我就是愛笑。

en: Laughing is the best medicine! Oh, I love comedies too!
zh: 笑是最好的良藥！喔，我也喜歡喜劇片！

en: You know, talking about things we dislike can actually be... even more fun and relatable!
zh: 你知道嗎，談論我們不喜歡的事其實……會更有趣、更讓人有共鳴！

en: That's so true! Alex... what is a food you dislike?
zh: 說得太對了！Alex……有沒有什麼你不喜歡的食物？

en: Oh, I do not like olives. I... I really cannot stand the taste!
zh: 喔，我不喜歡橄欖。我……我真的受不了那味道！

en: Olives? Really? ...I actually love olives!
zh: 橄欖？真的嗎？……我其實很喜歡橄欖！

en: Haha, we are opposites again! What about you, Mia? Any... any food you dislike?
zh: 哈哈，我們又相反了！你呢，Mia？有沒有……有什麼食物不喜歡？

en: Hmm, I don't like spicy food. Hot food is... definitely not for me!
zh: 嗯，我不喜歡吃辣。辣的食物……絕對不適合我！

en: What about daily activities? ...Is there anything you dislike?
zh: 那日常活動呢？……有沒有什麼你不喜歡的？

en: Oh, I don't like waking up early. I am definitely... not a morning person!
zh: 喔，我不喜歡早起。我絕對不是……早起型的人！

en: Haha, I totally agree! Getting enough sleep is... just so important.
zh: 哈哈，我完全同意！睡飽真的……太重要了。

en: What about you, Alex? What... what activity do you dislike?
zh: 你呢，Alex？有沒有……什麼活動是不喜歡的？

en: I don't like waiting in long lines. It is... oh, so boring!
zh: 我不喜歡排長隊。那真是……好無聊！

en: Haha! Well, nobody likes waiting in long lines!
zh: 哈哈！嗯，誰都不喜歡排長隊！

en: See? When you put these simple pieces together... you have a complete, natural introduction!
zh: 看吧？當你把這些簡單的片段拼在一起……你就有了一個完整、自然的自我介紹！

en: For example, I could say... 'Hi, I'm Alex. I'm an English teacher. I love dogs, pizza, and... well, rock music! But... I don't like waiting in line.'
zh: 例如，我可以說……「嗨，我是 Alex。我是英文老師。我喜歡狗、披薩，還有……嗯，搖滾樂！但……我不喜歡排隊。」

en: And I can say... 'Hi, I'm Mia. I'm an art student. I love cats, pasta, and painting... but, oh, I don't like waking up early!'
zh: 我可以說……「嗨，我是 Mia。我是藝術系學生。我喜歡貓、義大利麵，和畫畫……但，喔，我不喜歡早起！」

en: See? It's simple, authentic... and, well, full of personality!
zh: 看吧？很簡單、真實……而且，嗯，充滿個性！

en: Wow... time flies when you're having fun! We—well, we covered so many useful phrases today.
zh: 哇……有趣的時光總是過得很快！我們——嗯，今天覆蓋了好多實用片語。

en: Now, it's your turn to practice! Here is... today's Daily Challenge!
zh: 現在，輪到你練習了！這是……今天的每日挑戰！

en: We really, really want to get to know you! So... please answer in the comments below:
zh: 我們真的、非常想認識你！所以……請在下面留言回答：

en: Tell us... 'What do you do?'—or, share one favorite thing, and one dislike!
zh: 告訴我們……「你是做什麼的？」—或者，分享一件你喜歡的事和一件不喜歡的事！

en: Yeah! You can write... 'I am a student', 'I am a nurse'... or even, 'I love pizza and dogs'!
zh: 是啊！你可以寫……「我是學生」、「我是護理師」……甚至「我喜歡披薩和狗」！

en: Oh! Alex and I will personally read your comments... and give hearts to our favorites!
zh: 喔！Alex 和我會親自閱讀你們的留言……並把愛心給我們最喜歡的留言！

en: And... don't forget to check the description box below! You can use our free tools to practice—well, everything we learned today.
zh: 還有……別忘了查看下面的描述欄！你可以用我們的免費工具練習——嗯，今天學到的所有內容。

en: Yes! Whether it's intensive listening... or one-on-one AI speaking... it's all completely free! Go give it a try!
zh: 對！不管是密集聽力練習……或是一對一的 AI 口說……全部都是完全免費！去試試看吧！

en: If you enjoyed today's video... please like, subscribe to the AB English Podcast, and share with your friends!
zh: 如果你喜歡今天的影片……請按讚、訂閱 AB English Podcast，並分享給你的朋友！

en: Thank you so much for learning with us today. Remember...
zh: 非常感謝你今天和我們一起學習。記得……

en: Always... Better... Everyday!
zh: 永遠……變得更好……每天！

en: See you next time!
zh: 下次見！

en: See you next time! Bye-bye!
zh: 下次見！拜拜！
